caption: The drawing presents a sleeveless vest-like garment displayed on a mannequin torso, centered against a light beige background. The garment is primarily off-white or cream-colored, decorated with vertical rows of small, stylized floral motifs in colors including green, pink, blue, and light brown. The collar and front opening, as well as the edge of the lower hem, are trimmed with a dark blue or navy patterned border featuring a repeating geometric design. The garment has two pockets, one on each side near the bottom front, each outlined in matching blue trim and adorned with additional floral motifs and a bird perched on a branch. The front is fastened by small buttons along the opening. The overall effect is a detailed depiction of a decorative, embroidered waistcoat or vest, with precise renderings of both botanical and avian elements.
title: Waistcoat
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
